scope: Actual named release EXE/PCK; engine one-second FPS observations include cold startup and output logging. Exact owned-HWND physical client pixels, foreground and visibility/minimization are sampled roughly every500ms and validated. Unavailable-handle startup/shutdown boundaries are retained and explicitly excluded; an interior missing window fails. Sampling does not prove continuous focus or unobscured presentation. Failed diagnostics retain partial samples and raw logs.

window_assessment.scope: Only contiguous unavailable-handle startup/shutdown boundaries are excluded, explicitly counted and retained. Every available sample must prove exact owned HWND client pixels, foreground, visibility and non-minimization. Approximately 500ms samples do not prove continuous focus, unobscured presentation, displayed frames, GPU time or input latency. Process memory is sampled working set/private committed bytes, not GPU memory or proof of a leak.

phases.scope: Coarse stdout ordering only. Each FPS line spans about the preceding second and may cross an anchor; it is not an active-frame timing bucket. Effects may persist after the last attempt. No cold/idle or active-only FPS average is inferred.

frame_present_tool_availability.scope: Read-only PATH and named-directory availability check only; no executable, service or capture is started. WPR availability alone is not a configured frame-present trace. No machine-wide installation inventory is claimed.
